description: CMIS datapath bring-up: plug -> TRANSCEIVER_STATUS_SW.cmis_state == READY.
excludes: inter_state_dwell: CMIS_INTER_STATE_DWELL_MS = 1000 (cmis_manager_task.rs:81) deliberately holds each datapath state for 1s, which the Python reference does not do. Bring-up will look ~6-8s slower by construction. Either build a dwell=0 variant or report bring-up excluding dwell and say so - otherwise this benchmarks an invented artefact.
notes: Implemented in the DUT harness (benchmark/dut/xbench.py): ./tools/run_dut_bench.sh B3 --variants rust,python
